decisions.quote: Using a larger sample (84 subjects) with adequate statistical power (ranging from 0.75 to 0.95 across analyses), we failed to replicate any of the nine specific neuroimaging correlates of personality presented by Gao et al.
decisions.reason: Both the shipped record and blind coding agree that the paper is a replication testing previously published findings in an independent sample of 84 participants.
